title: Juice N Power Grape Ice Power 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Grape Ice Power from Juice N Power is a simple, classic blend that delivers an irresistible rush of flavour and refreshment with every vape. Juicy-sweet and tangy dark grapes are layered with waves of icy-cool menthol for a sweet and refreshing all-day vape. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
